How the schedule works

  1. Supabase Cron calls your protected Vercel endpoint every minute.
  2. Due watches are queued without duplicates.
  3. Your browser worker claims one check and reads the CGHS slot page.
  4. The result appears here. Login expiry pauses the watch.

A worker needs a running computer, or a server with a browser and manual login access. Scheduling does not remove CGHS OTP or session expiry.
